# What is Granular?

In short

Granular is a desktop app for Mac and Windows where an AI agent builds and runs tasks on your computer, using the Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for.

Updated 2026-11-03

Granular is a desktop app where you ask an AI agent for things in plain English, and it does the work on your computer. It writes files, runs commands and builds pages inside a real terminal that you can watch the whole time, and it shows you the result in a preview.

It runs on macOS, and on Windows as a beta.

A terminal is a text window where you type instructions to a computer. It's what developers use. In Granular, the agent types into it for you, so you never have to.

## Who it's for [...] Claude's agent is built into Granular and can run on your own Claude plan. Granular wraps it in a desktop app with a chat, a live preview, a file viewer, several sessions at once and connected apps, and you can still watch or use the terminal yourself.

 Is Granular free?

Yes, Granular is free to download and use with your own AI connection. The Pro plan lifts the Free plan's limits, and the AI Add-on is a separate purchase if you want Granular to supply the AI. See Plans and pricing.

 Can a team use it together?

Each person runs Granular on their own computer with their own projects. Several agents can work together on one computer with Boss and worker agents.

## Related

Getting started

Your first session [...] ## What Granular is not

 Not an AI model. Granular needs an AI connection to do anything. Without one, the agent can't work.
 Not a website host. Published links put a copy of one page or note on a Granular web address. Granular doesn't host full websites or connect your own domain. The agent can help you set up a hosting service yourself.
 Not a cloud workspace. Your projects live on your computer, not in Granular's servers. They don't sync between computers.

## Next steps

1. Install it: Install Granular on macOS or Install Granular on Windows (beta).
2. Connect an AI model: Connect an AI model.
3. Try it: Your first session. A good first task is Build a landing page.

## The answers you're looking for.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. That's the whole point. You ask in plain English; agents do the real work in real terminals, in full view. If you can write a text message, you can run Granular. And if you do know your way around a terminal, it's a real one. Type away.

 Which AI agents work with it today?

Claude Code and Codex, through your own logins. Your subscription, your usage, never resold. Gemini is next on the bench, and the AI Add-on gives you hosted models inside Granular if you'd rather skip accounts entirely.
